title: The Extreme World of Ultra Intense Lasers - with Kate Lancaster
summary: Royal Institution lecture by Dr Kate Lancaster on the most powerful lasers in the world and the extreme conditions they create. It includes live demonstrations and covers applications from industry to fusion.
why: Recommended as an accessible, well-delivered lecture on high-intensity laser physics.

quote.text: Here's a great Royal Institution Lecture by Kate Lancaster talking about Ultra Intense Lasers from 2017
